tutorial_text.text:
GUARD POSITION

This tri-arrow graphic visualizes the guard position of you and your opponent.

By default, the same controls used for hitting notes switches your guard position.



DEFENSE

Match your guard direction to an attack before it occurs to block.



Parrying is an enhanced block performed by attacking before a block occurs,

granting a temporary full-block benefit, and restoring some health and stamina.



OFFENSE

To attack, press the "$attackBind" input.



The opponent will block any attack while they are not performing a combat action.

However, most characters will have their own means to land attacks.

It is best to treat the opponent as if they will always block when possible.



VICTORY

There are two victory types: A "singing" victory, and a "combat" victory.

A singing victory occurs on reaching the end of a song, while a combat victory occurs if the opponent's health is also depleted.
